paper_title: First results of the SUPAX Experiment: Probing Dark Photons
notes: First results of SUPAX haloscope at Mainz: 8.3 GHz (8303.06 MHz) copper cavity at 4.2 K, 126 min run without magnetic field. Single-frequency proof-of-concept limit chi < (6.20 +/- 3.15(exp) +/- 9.65(SG)) x 10^-14 at 95% CL for m_A' = 34.34 ueV, assuming randomly polarised DP field and rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3. The central value 6.20e-14 already includes the factor-5 correction for unaccounted analysis losses. Fixed-polarization limit is chi < 38e-14. Emitted as single point since limit applies at one frequency only. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.9, 1))
